network_state: Line 420 diverted in Horní Bludovice (from 14 Oct 2026)

The CIS JŘ export has a diversion timetable for 420 valid from 14 Oct to the end of the timetable year (12 Dec 2026): Horní Bludovice, Záguří and Bludovice, U Kasperčoka are not served. It runs on the vehicle day and has no announced end, so it is modelled.
Night lines only; not in the afternoon model.
One afternoon trip each on the vehicle day (414 Dolní Datyně – Podlesí, 503 Lazy – Lutyně); run by buses of other lines, not modelled.
branches_why: A line's terminus pairs are its Simutrans lines when they carry at least 3 trips each way in 15:00–18:00 with a departure in the peak hour, or at least 3 trips each way in 13:00–19:00 (regular afternoon branches); the pair with the most trips is always one. Short workings and depot runs are folded into the main row. Circular lines are one Simutrans line with one timed entry.
terminus_alias_why: Buses for Bludovice, Těrlicko and Dolní Datyně leave from Podlesí, Těšínská, 2 min from the bus station where they arrive (as Ostrava's Vozovna trolejbusů / sad Boženy Němcové): one terminus.
coverage_rule: Owner, 20 Oct 2026: "501 is the only line running to Dětmarovice, how can we not model that?" Every stop the sheet's lines serve in 13:00–19:00 must be on a modelled Simutrans line, or be listed with the reason. Where the branch rule misses a place, the line is set by hand (config.line_overrides, as Ostrava 41).

lines.why: Read at its core points (Lazy, Lutyně, Dětmarovice, železniční stanice), the Orlová trunk is one hourly bus: Lazy :06, back from Lutyně :30–:35. In odd hours it goes on to Dětmarovice (Lazy :06, Dětmarovice :18 in even hours, also on the trips that start further out at Elektrárna or Koukolná). As in Ex4: 501 is that Dětmarovice service, every 2 hours, written as every 480 with three slots so that the fourth slot belongs to 501B (Koukolná). 501's own trips use the path via Poruba, kulturní dům and Lutyně, Zátiší.

legs.src: 501 11:06 (passes Dětmarovice, železniční stanice 11:43); 504 15:06; 13:06 has no real trip (501's 12:58 turns at Lutyně)
501 12:15 from Elektrárna (Dětmarovice, železniční stanice 12:18); 501 16:18 (on at 16:35 from Lutyně); 14:18 has no real trip

lines.name: 501B
lines.why: The Dětmarovice trips that go beyond the railway station to Elektrárna Dětmarovice and Koukolná (the only service to Elektrárna, mateřská škola and Koukolná): Lazy 9:06 and 17:06 (8 hours apart), back from Koukolná at :09 (10:09, 18:09) so that it passes the railway station at :18, the knot it shares with 501. The fourth slot of 501's 2-hour pattern, as Ex4/2 and Ex4/3 are every 480 beside Ex4/1.

501 10:15 from Elektrárna and 18:09 from Koukolná, both through Dětmarovice, železniční stanice at :18; timed at Koukolná (:09) so the bus passes the station at :18

lines.why: The other half of the hourly Orlová trunk (owner, 20 Oct 2026: "Could we take 503 to be one of the legs of the 501/504?"). In even hours the bus leaves Lazy at :06 and turns at Lutyně, back at :35 in odd hours. 503's 14:00 trip is that even-hour departure by the other path, via Lazy, Důl Lazy, Veverka, Poliklinika and škola, so 504 is one circuit every 240 that alternates the two paths: via Poruba, škola at 8:06, 12:06, 16:06, via Důl Lazy at 10:06, 14:06, 18:06 (503's real 14:00 is 6 min earlier). 504's own Dětmarovice trips (8:06 and 18:06 to the railway station, 9:06 to Elektrárna) are the odd ones out: Dětmarovice is 501's and 501B's.

504 through Lutyně to Lazy at :35 in odd hours (9:30, 13:35, 17:35)
503 14:00 via Důl Lazy; 504 10:06 and 18:06 take this slot via Poruba, škola in reality
504 through Lutyně to Lazy at :35 in odd hours (11:30, 15:35, 19:30)

503.why: 503's afternoon trip (Lazy 14:00 via Důl Lazy to Lutyně) is the even-hour trunk departure by the other path: it is a leg of Simutrans line 504, which alternates the two paths every 2 hours. Its other trip (4:37 Město, Mezilesí → Lazy) is morning only.

lines.name: 417C
lines.why: A third 417 bus shuttles Podlesí (Těšínská) :50 → Těrlicko, obecní úřad, back :00, at 14:50 and 15:50 (about nine trips a day in all).

One bus from Město, železniční stanice: to Podlesí 13:30 and back 14:18, to Šenov 15:15 and back 15:45. Bent onto a circuit every 240 (no daily lines, owner): Podlesí at 9:30, 13:30, 17:30 …, Šenov at 11:15, 15:15, 19:15 …, 1 bus. It is the only service to Město, Na Prostředňáku, Formanská and Na Fojtství and to the Šenov stops. Off the pattern: the 12:45 and 18:10 Šenov trips and the 16:50 trip to Bludovice (other lines serve Bludovice).

lines.name: 402B
lines.why: Stonava, sídliště Nový svět is served only by 402. At midday the Šumbark :23 departure goes to Stonava instead of Albrechtice. Bent onto every 480 (no daily lines, owner): Šumbark 12:23 (also 4:23, 20:23, clear of the afternoon peak), back from Stonava 13:05 (5:05, 21:05). Real Stonava trips also run at 5:25–8:20, 11:23 and 12:53 (off the pattern).

One bus, back to back: Podlesí (Těšínská) 14:09, 15:05 and 16:50 → Horní Bludovice, Adámek, back 14:38, 15:33 and 17:21 (then 18:25 to Lapačka as 411B, and 19:50 / 20:21). Method check, 25 Oct 2026: the hand-set hourly pattern (Podlesí :05 / Adámek :33) had 4 slots in 14:00-18:00 and only 15:05 / 15:33 on the real trips (14:09 and 14:38 4-5 min off, nothing at 16:05 / 16:33, 16:50 and 17:21 12-15 min off), so it failed the Step 4 test; no hourly or 2-hourly pattern passes. Every 480 with the three afternoon trips each way is exact (the 290 precedent: an exact multi-slot row on a long interval), 1 bus as before; it repeats at 6:09 / 7:05 / 8:50 (real 6:05) and 22:09-1:21. The simpler option, hourly at :05 / :33 (1 bus), is the owner's choice.

lines.why: The evening trip to Šenov, Lapačka is the only service to Šenov, křižovatka k Dolní Datyni. Bent onto every 480 (no daily lines, owner): Podlesí 18:25 (also 2:25, 10:25), back 19:05.

A mine shift line, the only service to Důl Darkov and Doly, zastávka ČSA. Shifts change every 8 hours, so every 480: Fryštát 12:22 (also 4:22 and 20:22), back from Důl Darkov :10 (6:10, 14:10, 22:10). The out slot is the afternoon trip, the only one in the line's window (method check, 25 Oct 2026: the earlier 12:54 slot was 32 min from it and failed the Step 4 test); the early and late trips (4:54, 5:14, 20:56) are off the pattern.

lines.why: 401 and 406 run as one ring in the timetable: 406 Podlesí → Pašůvka goes on as 401 Pašůvka → Šumbark, and 401 Šumbark → Prostřední Suchá at :14 and :59 goes on as 406 back to Podlesí. Each line has only half of the ring, so each is one circuit here, joined by the one-stop hop between Prostřední Suchá, železniční stanice and Horní Suchá, Pašůvka. Pooling 401 + 406 as one ring line would be the owner's choice.

Bent onto every 160 (no daily lines, owner; 160 divides 1440): also 7:10, 9:50, 17:50, 20:30. The 17:30 / 18:00 trips to Těrlicko, obecní úřad run over 417's stops.

One bus shuttling Šumbark, točna 2. etapa ⇄ Město, obchodní dům about hourly but irregularly (Šumbark 13:15, 14:10, 15:30, 16:20, 18:07, 19:00; obchodní dům 13:50, 14:50, 15:50, 17:00, 18:30). Method check, 25 Oct 2026: the automatic fit, every 60 at :25 / :55, had none of the line's real departures within 3 min all day (every one 5-25 min off) and failed the Step 4 test. Every 160 with two slots each way is the real afternoon: Šumbark 15:30 and 16:20, obchodní dům 15:50 and 17:00, repeating at 18:10 / 19:00 and 18:30 (real 18:07, 19:00, 18:30), 1 bus as before. The simpler option, every 60 at :25 / :55 (up to 5 min off in 15:30-17:30, 1 bus), is the owner's choice.

Circular from Fryštát, hourly at :50 from 8:50 to 15:50; after that 17:05 and 18:10.
One bus to Darkov, lázně and back, drifting through the day; over the whole day the commonest minutes are Fryštát :15 (10:15, 11:15, 12:15, 16:15) and Darkov :36 (10:36, 11:36, 12:36, 16:36).

review: Owner, 20 Oct 2026: "Is the lines the best schedule that fits my intent (not necessarily the scripts)? Or can you do a version that fits better". Each line was checked by hand against its real afternoon timetable; where the automatic fit was approximate for an artefact (merged variant minutes, a sparse-window rule) the line is hand-set in line_overrides.
core_points_rule: Owner, 20 Oct 2026: "Look at how I did in the save game Ex4 - there is also a very irregular service, but I defined it in core points, created a repeating interval and it suddenly made sense. 501 mostly goes to Dětmarovice, žel.st. some elsewhere." Ex4 in the save: one line per destination (Ex4/1 every 240, Ex4/2 and Ex4/3 every 480), timetabled only at core points (termini, Bohumín, Břeclav). Here: a line's trips are read at its core points over the whole day, the repeating interval is found there, and destination variants get their own Simutrans line on a longer interval, offset so they don't run together.
max_interval_rule: Owner, 20 Oct 2026: "Now I don't like 1440 lines - in game that is not found. 8 hrs should be the very maximal interval (still not preferred). If the only way to model 1440 is 1440 reconsider - we can bend the reality a bit." No daily timetables; the longest interval is 480, shorter where the real trips repeat; sparse trips are bent onto a repeating slot or folded into a line they belong to.
